sources.title: Major waste companies largely pass diesel price spike along to customers
sources.excerpt: Diesel prices cost haulers tens of millions of dollars in Q3, spurring WM, GFL and others to increase surcharges. Republic and Waste Connections are also using AI tools for pricing and cost cutting.
